name: Snapbug-no-op
summary: Inert build of the Snapbug SDK for Release configurations.
description:
The release twin of the Snapbug pod: same `import SnapbugSDK` / `import Snapbug` API, every
call a no-op. Link it in Release and the live pod in Debug, and shipping builds neither carry
the inspector UI nor show the debug overlay to end users.

    pod 'Snapbug',       :configurations => ['Debug']
    pod 'Snapbug-no-op', :configurations => ['Release']
